description: This file contains utility functions for integrating Cypress test results with Zephyr Scale test management system, including creating test cycles, saving test executions, and processing test report data.

methods.name: getStepStateResult
methods.description: Calculates the count of test steps by their state (passed, failed, etc.)

methods.name: getStepStateSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string of step states counts

methods.name: getTM4JTestCases
methods.description: Extracts and groups test cases from report results based on test case IDs

methods.name: saveToEndpoint
methods.description: Sends data to a specified API endpoint with authorization

methods.name: createTestCycle
methods.description: Creates a new test cycle in Zephyr Scale with environment variables

methods.name: createTestExecutions
methods.description: Creates test execution entries in Zephyr Scale for each test case in the report

methods.name: saveTestCases
methods.description: Main function to create test cycle and save test executions based on report

methods.name: saveTestExecution
methods.description: Saves individual test execution data, with retry logic on failure
